posts.external_title: Photocatalytic water splitting by 2D polymer with out-of-plane carrier flow - Nature
posts.external_description: A strategy using polymeric carbon nitride crystals induces out-of-plane carrier migration by means of internal electric fields applied on facet-selective nanofilms placed on polymer photocatalysts, increasing the apparent quantum efficiency for overall water splitting.
